---

**1. Matter 1018-00008** — Penterra Pharmaceuticals Corp. / Veridian Biosciences, Inc.
- **Financing:** $500,000,000 senior secured term loan facility (Commitment Letter Ref. CL-2024-PPCA-0607, dated June 7, 2024, from Summit Ridge Capital Partners, LP and Ironclad Trust Company, N.A.)
- **Termination:** The SPA was terminated on September 30, 2024, and the financing commitment was terminated on October 1, 2024.
- **Proof of termination:** `letter-ironclad-termination-commitment.docx` — Notice of Termination of Commitment to Ironclad Trust Company, N.A., dated October 1, 2024.

**2. Matter 1032-00005** — Halcyon Semiconductor AG / Vectris Photonics, Inc.
- **Financing:** $500,000,000 senior secured term loan facility (Commitment Letter dated August 8, 2023, from Meridian Atlantic Bank, N.A.)
- **Termination:** The Merger Agreement was terminated on November 30, 2023, and the financing commitment was terminated on December 1, 2023.
- **Proof of termination:** `letter-meridian-atlantic-commitment-termination.docx` — Termination of Commitment Letter to Meridian Atlantic Bank, N.A., dated December 1, 2023.

**3. Matter 1044-00002** — Thalassa Shipping & Logistics SA
- **Financing:** $150,000,000 senior secured revolving credit facility refinancing (arranged by Meridian Atlantic Bank)
- **Termination:** Meridian Atlantic withdrew from the mandate on July 19, 2023; the matter was wound down on August 14, 2023.
- **Proof of termination:** `disengagement-file-closure-letter.docx` — Disengagement and File Closure Letter, dated August 25, 2023.

**4. Matter 1021-00007** — Coral Palms Resort Holdings LLC / Pinnacle Atlantic Capital, LLC
- **Financing:** $160,000,000 first mortgage loan (Commitment Letter dated December 9, 2022)
- **Termination:** The Commitment Letter was terminated on February 15, 2023, due to material modification of terms by the lender.
- **Proof of termination:** `termination-notice.docx` — Termination of Commitment Letter, dated February 15, 2023.

**5. Matter 1009-00005** — Skybridge Fintech Ltd. / Halcyon Securities LLC
- **Financing:** $200,000,000 asset-backed securities offering (Preliminary Purchase Agreement dated February 20, 2024)
- **Termination:** The PPA was terminated on May 8, 2024, due to material servicing-data discrepancies.
- **Proof of termination:** `termination-notice-halcyon.docx` — Formal Notice of Termination, dated May 8, 2024.
